def: The standard text format for file changes: per-file headers, then hunks that start with @@ -l,s +l,s @@ and list context lines plus lines prefixed - (removed) or + (added).
practice: Git and patch use it; as an agent edit format it is compact, but models handle line numbers badly, so Aider tells them to omit line numbers and applies each hunk like a search-and-replace.
